segments.text: Which college running backs are most likely to become RB1s in the NFL? Here's what the Statable model says.
Number three: J'Koby Williams, Texas Tech. A twenty percent chance of at least one top twelve season in his first five years.
Number two: Jadan Baugh, Florida. Twenty one percent.
And number one: Cole Tabb, Cincinnati. Twenty six percent. He's putting up a hundred thirty one scrimmage yards a game, and he catches passes.
For context, only about one in six drafted running backs ever has an RB1 season.
Full board, and our track record, at statable F F dot com.
